line: Fuck a peace sign, I throw up my set
vault_lines: Fuck a peace sign, I throw up my set
meaning:
Herbo grew up in Terror Town, the east side of Chiraq. He is a member of NLMB standing for “No Limit Muskegon Boys” or “Never Leave My Brothers”.

The gang is an alliance of Black P Stones and the Muskegon Gangster Disciples. Him and Bibby are both part of it. Herb isn’t throwing any peace signs but gang signs.

line: Double cups and handles, I don’t fuck with liquor
vault_lines: Double cups and handles, I don't fuck with liquor
meaning:
Herb doesn’t fuck with alcohol and would rather sip purple drank. A double cup is 2 cups stacked on top of each other. Herb is talking about promethazine and codeine syrup mixed with sprite in the cup known as “Purple Drank”.

Herb also said in his Vlad interview that he spent more than $50,000 on purple drank. That’s a lot of purple he’s sipping.

line: Pockets XXL and extended magazines Ain’t no magazine cover, they just dodgin’ undercovers
meaning:
Juicy J uses Hip-Hop magazine XXL to describe the streets of North Memphis, playing with the word magazine (which can mean both publication and ammo cartridge), and XXl (double extra large).

Also, Lil Herb (who is featured on this track) was snubbed for a spot on the 2015 Freshman XXL cover, despite pleading his case on video.

line: Teachers told me I ain’t gon’ be shit I got rich and it ain’t no secret
vault_lines: Teachers told me I ain't gon' be shit
meaning: Juicy J most likely wasn’t the best student and teachers told him he wasn’t going to succeed in life. Now he has had one of the most storied careers in rap history and is a successful businessman who owns part the successful label that is Taylor Gang. This goes to show you that success can be achieved no matter who you are.
